I am a **lecturer (Asisten Ahli)** in the [Department of Electrical Engineering](https://teknik-elektro.fst.unja.ac.id/) at [Universitas Jambi](https://www.unja.ac.id/). My work centers on **Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Pattern Recognition** — with a focus on making them useful outside the lab, whether for agriculture, health, or industry.

Before joining Universitas Jambi in 2024, I worked as a **Data Scientist** at **Alfagift** (Global Loyalty Indonesia) and **kumparan**, where I built forecasting systems, segmentation models, and ML pipelines used by millions of people.

I hold an **M.Kom. from Universitas Indonesia** and an **S.Komp. from IPB University**. My papers appear in Scopus-indexed and SINTA-accredited venues — see [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=OaPOYtEAAAAJ&hl=id) and [SINTA](https://sinta.kemdiktisaintek.go.id/authors/profile/6931115).

## Selected Research

My research groups into four threads. Each one started from a concrete problem my students or collaborators brought to me:

- **Pattern Recognition and Computer Vision** — reading scanned forms, counting fish from images, classifying remote-sensing scenes, and detecting malaria parasites under the microscope.
- **Predictive Systems** — forecasting with SARIMA and LSTM, applied to energy exports and stock prices.
- **Clustering and Segmentation** — K-means and hierarchical methods for customer segments, provincial profiles, and fire hotspots.
- **Intelligent Systems** — small decision-support tools built for specific users, from village IoT monitors to pesantren administration.

## Featured Publications

A short sample. Full list with plain-language summaries on the [Publications page](publications/index.qmd).

1. **Transfer Learning for Remote Sensing Scene Classification** — which CNN/ViT transfers best for landscape scenes. *Jurnal Riset Informatika* 8(3), 2026. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.34288/jri.v8i3.515)
2. **Parameter-Efficient Models for Malaria Detection** — small-data, imbalanced blood-smear classification. *Kinetik* 11(2), 2026. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.22219/kinetik.v11i2.2558)
3. **Multi-Architecture CNN for Automated Malaria Detection** — comparing YOLO and CNN variants on microscopy images. *PROCA* 2(2), 2026. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.22437/proca.v2i2.55514)
4. **Automatic Counting from Scanned Election Forms** — feature matching + CNN. *ICACSIS 2019* (Scopus). [IEEE](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/)
5. **Random Forest for Sentinel-2 Land Cover in Jambi** — improving accuracy on local landscape. *Jurnal Ilmu Komputer (Fasilkom UMRI)*. [PDF](https://ejurnal.umri.ac.id/index.php/JIK/article/download/8886/3478)

## Selected Projects

- **Automated Fish Counter** — Android + embedded vision to measure, count, and sort fish. [GitHub](https://github.com/akhiyarwaladi/Automated-Fish-Counter) · [Devpost](https://devpost.com/software/automated-fish-counter)
- **IoT FST Dashboard** — live sensor monitoring for the faculty. [GitHub](https://github.com/akhiyarwaladi/iot_fst_dashboard)
- **Fire Spot** — hierarchical clustering of fire hotspots in Bangka Belitung. [GitHub](https://github.com/akhiyarwaladi/fire_spot)
- **ML Tutorials** — hands-on notebooks for my classes. [GitHub](https://github.com/akhiyarwaladi/ml_tutorial)

More detail on the [Projects page](projects/index.qmd).
